SELECT
FROM sgtransit_phone_verification WHERE phone=#{phone} AND challenge_scope=#{scope} ORDER BY requested_at DESC, verification_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_phone_verification ( phone, challenge_scope, code_hash, verification_token_hash, failed_attempts, requested_at, code_expires_at, verified_at, token_expires_at, used_at ) VALUES ( #{phone}, #{challengeScope}, #{codeHash}, #{verificationTokenHash}, #{failedAttempts}, #{requestedAt}, #{codeExpiresAt}, #{verifiedAt}, #{tokenExpiresAt}, #{usedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_phone_verification SET verification_token_hash=#{verificationTokenHash}, failed_attempts=#{failedAttempts}, verified_at=#{verifiedAt}, token_expires_at=#{tokenExpiresAt}, used_at=#{usedAt} WHERE verification_no=#{verificationNo}
